description: 20-Foot Equivalent Units (TEU) Handled by Select U.S. Container Ports January 2020 to August 2023 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. TEU Throughput tracks the actual volume of container traffic moving through U.S. gateways. While 'capacity' measures the potential slots available on ships, 'throughput' measures the realized trade, the boxes moved on and off the vessels. From January 2020 to August 2023, U.S. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 11 columns, among them Los Angeles, Oakland, Savannah, Sea-Tac, Unnamed Column, Charleston. The portal shows 2024-01-12 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
